abilities.name: Purifying Salt
abilities.effect: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.flavor_text: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.effect: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
abilities.flavor_text: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.effect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.effect: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

abilities.name: Prism Armor
abilities.effect: Reduces super-effective damage to 0.75×.
abilities.flavor_text: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

abilities.name: Neuroforce
abilities.effect: Increases super-effective damage dealt to 1.25×.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up moves that are super effective.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
abilities.flavor_text: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

abilities.name: Stakeout
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
abilities.flavor_text: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.effect: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

abilities.name: Magnet Pull
abilities.effect: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.
abilities.flavor_text: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.effect: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Simple
abilities.effect: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers.  These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.
abilities.flavor_text: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.effect: Prevents confusion.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.effect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.effect: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
